notes.37: Question 37 but some candidates’ answers were invalidated by the inclusion of other activities such as film and musique . In Question 38 , only the more able scored the mark here by correctly identifying grand-père and a significant number of candidates just answered père . In the next question, candidates were required to identify parler and the vast majority of the candidates, across the ability range, were able to do that. The final question was seen as perhaps the most challenging in the whole exam and many candidates incorrectly answered supermarché .
